body.name: \dot{\mathfrak R}_T[h]
body.def: for \(P\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\) and any ambient empirical-process direction \(h\) with \(h[1]=0\), the recursion obtained from \(\mathfrak R_T(P)\) by the ordinary product and chain rules on \(D_t^{\star}=\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\), with \(\dot\mu_t[h]=h[U_t]+P[\dot U_t[h]]\), \(\dot K_{rs}[h]=h[U_rU_s]+P[\dot U_r[h]U_s+U_r\dot U_s[h]]\), \(\dot\lambda_t[h]=K_{D_t^{\star}D_t^{\star}}^{-1}\{\dot K_{D_t^{\star},t}[h]-\dot K_{D_t^{\star}D_t^{\star}}[h]\lambda_t\}\), \(\dot\rho_t[h]=\dot K_{tt}[h]-2\dot K_{t,D_t^{\star}}[h]\lambda_t+\lambda_t^{\top}\dot K_{D_t^{\star}D_t^{\star}}[h]\lambda_t\), and \(\dot H_t[h]=\dot\lambda_t[h]^{\top}H_{D_t^{\star}}+\lambda_t^{\top}\dot H_{D_t^{\star}}[h]+\dot\rho_t[h]Z_t^{\circ}/(2\sqrt{\rho_t})\). Finally, \(\dot Y_{t+1}[h]=\dot\mu_t[h]+\sqrt{\sigma^2}\dot H_t[h]\).
